▶  Block: POST /api/v1/auth/login  |  Input dimensions: credentials, account status, body validation

column10:
data.accessToken matches ^[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+$ (HS256 JWT)
data.refreshToken non-blank
data.tokenType = "Bearer"
data.expiresIn > 0
data.requiresFirstLoginSetup = false
column15: Real Tomcat + real login: the token is signed by JwtTokenServiceImpl and later verified by NimbusJwtDecoder

column10:
error_code VAL_001, message "Dữ liệu không hợp lệ"
details[] names both employeeCode and password
column15: Bean validation answers 422, not the conventional 400 — same across the whole API

column10: error_code REQ_001, message "Mã nhân viên hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác"
column15: Contract divergence: credentials failure is BadRequestException → 400 REQ_001, while the TDS 8.1 registry implies AUTH_001

column10: error_code REQ_001 with the identical message to a wrong password — the response does not reveal whether the account exists
column15: Good: no account enumeration here (contrast with L3-AUTH-12)

column10:
error_code AUTH_001, message "Tài khoản đã bị khóa"
no tokens issued

column1: ▶  Block: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token, /auth/logout  |  Input dimensions: token validity, revocation, replay

column10:
data.employeeCode = caller's code
data.id = caller's user id
column15: Proves NimbusJwtDecoder HS256 verification + CustomJwtAuthenticationConverter — the part MockMvc's jwt() post-processor bypasses

column10:
data.accessToken is new and authenticates GET /me → 200
data.refreshToken unchanged (no rotation, D25)
error_code AUTH_001, message "Refresh token không hợp lệ"

error_code AUTH_001, message "Token đã bị thu hồi"
DB: refresh_tokens.revoked = true
both calls 200; the row stays revoked = true
column15: Logout is one of the six permitAll matchers, so no access token is needed and replay is harmless

column1: ▶  Block: POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password  |  Input dimensions: email existence, OTP state, password rules

column10:
DB: password_reset_otp row, 6 digits, used = false, expires in 5 min
exactly one email queued to that address
column15: Email captured at the EmailProducer boundary (CapturingEmailProducerConfig) — no broker in the test profile

column10:
error_code REQ_001, message "Không tìm thấy email"
no email queued
column15: D39: the distinct message lets an attacker enumerate registered emails — unlike the login path, which stays uniform

column10:
DB: OTP row used = true
login with the new password → 200
column15: Password and OTP flip in the same transaction

column8: the same body replayed after a successful reset
column10: error_code REQ_001, message "Mã OTP đã được sử dụng"
error_code VAL_001, details[] names newPassword (@Size min 4)
column15: Validation runs before the OTP lookup, so a wrong OTP is never reported here
